documents.name: Valid Passport or National ID
documents.description: Your original passport or national identity card. It must be valid and not expired. Bring the original — copies are not accepted.

documents.name: Visa or Residence Permit
documents.description: If you are a non-EU citizen, bring your valid visa or residence permit. EU citizens do not need this.

documents.name: University Enrollment Certificate
documents.description: A current enrollment certificate (Immatrikulationsbescheinigung) from your German university. This confirms your student status.

documents.name: Rental Agreement or Lease Contract
documents.description: Your signed rental contract (Mietvertrag) showing your German address. This proves where you are living.

documents.name: Landlord Confirmation (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung)
documents.description: A signed confirmation from your landlord stating that you have moved into the apartment. This is legally required and your landlord must provide it. You can download the form from your city's official website.

documents.name: Registration Form (Anmeldeformular)
documents.description: The official registration form, which you can download and fill in before your appointment, or complete at the Bürgeramt. Available on your city's website.

documents.name: Marriage Certificate
documents.description: Only required if you are registering a spouse at the same address.

documents.name: Birth Certificates of Children
documents.description: Only required if you are registering children at the same address.
